Welcome.Title: Welcome to your birthday party ❤️
Welcome.Message: Tonight, this little world belongs to you.

Gifts.Title: I have one more surprise for you 🎁

Letter.Title: A little letter for you
Letter.Text:
My dearest Piu,

Even though we are far apart today, I wanted to create something that felt like a real celebration. Every balloon, every sparkle, and every surprise in this little digital world was made just for you.

Happy Birthday.

With all my love,
Yours

FinalMessage.Title: Happy Birthday ❤️
FinalMessage.Message:
Even though I can't be there beside you today, I wanted to bring a little piece of my celebration to you.

From far away, but always close to your heart.
